report_comment.text: RUNX1 encodes the DNA-binding alpha subunit of core-binding factor, a regulator of hematopoiesis. MECOM encodes EVI1/MDS1-associated transcriptional regulators of hematopoiesis. RUNX1::MECOM is a recurrent t(3;21)-associated rearrangement in myeloid neoplasia, including secondary AML and CML blast phase. MECOM-rearranged AML is assigned adverse genetic risk under adult ELN 2022 intensive-treatment criteria.
